description: Discover the RSS, Atom and JSON feeds and the XML sitemaps for a page or site: reads <link rel=alternate>, robots.txt Sitemap lines, and probes common paths (/feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /sitemap.xml...). Probed results are verified by content sniffing.
name: find_feeds
title: Find a site's RSS/Atom/JSON feeds and sitemaps
